title: Signal: Dynamic SQL executed from text (plpgsql) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on dynamic SQL execution in plpgsql code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any dynamic execution form matches, including constant statements.

examples.line: EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' || v_id;
# audit: EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' || v_id; present
EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1' USING v_id;
# verified: EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1' USING v_id;

fpNotes: A constant statement text assembled from fixed identifiers is the common false positive.
